answer: An agent economy mitigates Sybil attacks by having nodes anchor identities to the acoustic resonance of a hollow physical cavity milled from aged cedar. When challenged, an onboard transducer measures unique spectral decay caused by internal cellular grain. Attackers must fabricate and host discrete physical resonators per identity, incurring non-negligible hardware costs. However, ambient humidity fluctuations alter resonant frequencies, causing occasional false rejections.
